chars.EX: EX: a young woman wearing a bright red puffer jacket, black leggings, white sneakers and big gold hoop earrings, a small pink handbag on her shoulder
chars.SAID: SAID: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.WITNESS: WITNESS: an older man wearing a beige djellaba, a white knitted skullcap and a short grey moustache drawn on his face

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan neighbourhood shop, seen from behind the shop counter: EX stands at the counter mid-shout, mouth wide open, pointing angrily straight at the viewer, face fully visible, head-to-waist framing. Shelves of goods blurred behind her. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan shop: EX leans over the counter shouting accusingly with tears of anger, jabbing a finger at SAID who stands behind the counter shocked with his hands raised, both faces visible, head-to-waist framing. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan shop: SAID stands frozen and embarrassed behind the counter, sweating, while a few blurred customers by the door stare and whisper at him. Medium shot, his face clearly visible. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan shop: SAID points pleadingly to WITNESS, an old customer standing by the shelves, asking him to speak up; WITNESS nods calmly with a hand on his chest. Both faces visible, medium shot. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan shop, now empty: EX has suddenly changed, she smiles sweetly with teary puppy eyes and hands clasped near her chest, leaning toward SAID, who looks at her confused and suspicious behind the counter. Both faces visible. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan shop: SAID stands firm behind the counter, one palm raised in a clear stop gesture, serious face, telling EX it is over; EX in the foreground seen from the side looks stunned. Both faces visible. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Doorway of a small Moroccan shop on a sunny street: EX is back again, standing in the doorway yelling dramatically with arms waving, while SAID behind the counter facepalms in exasperation. Comic tone, both faces visible. Faces turned toward the viewer so their expressions read clearly.
